core_obligations: The author builds a permutation-indexed left-to-right-minima basis by a unitriangular expansion, identifies its spans with the refinement-poset filtration, and proves scalar descent-algebra actions on the filtration quotients. The compatibility proof uses nested Dynkin commutators and precise rearrangement/coset identities, supplying an adapted basis and triangular action rather than only a single permutation relation. Basis, filtration and scalar-quotient forms are one object.
